const ans = `IDEA: GYROSUCC-SUPERPOSE
TITLE: Curvature-anchored successor superposition of item latents at the RQ-VAE encoder/quantizer interface
MOTIVATION: RQ-VAE SIDs are built from item content, so the first-level prefix groups items that look alike, not items that are followed by alike things. A generative next-SID predictor then has to learn temporal structure through a partition that was never organised around it. Training transitions are tree-like because users branch into interests; a Euclidean average of successor embeddings moves points inward and collapses those branches toward the origin, erasing exactly the radial distinction the predictor needs.
NOVELTY: The coupling is placed before quantization, not in the assignment matrix, the codebook update, the residual chain, the curvature-per-branch rule or a prefix score. One gyrovector superposition layer sits between the existing RQ-VAE encoder and the residual quantizer; the quantizer, the codebook update and the reconstruction loss code are untouched. The per-item step size is derived from measured successor degree and successor entropy, and the latent is rescaled into the ball by a measured median norm so the curvature is materially active rather than decorative. This is not a re-run of the #126 prefix-rank proxy: the frozen #126 hard Q_H is only recomputed afterwards as a read-only diagnostic, never optimised here.
CHANGE: Replace the encoder output E_i that is fed to the RQ levels by h_i, the point reached by moving from E_i along the geodesic toward the weighted tangent-space mean of its training successors, with a branching-derived step size; the codebook is still learned by the existing Euclidean RQ-VAE loss against the same reconstruction target.
SPECIFICATION: Build A once from training transitions; set K to the measured 90th percentile of out-degree and keep the top-K successors per row; measure s once from the median latent norm and cache C_j = Pi(s*f_theta(x_j)) for all training items at each epoch boundary (detached); per batch compute u_i = sum_j p_ij log_{E_i}(C_j), alpha_i = 1/(1+ln(1+d_i)+H_i), h_i = exp_{E_i}(alpha_i*u_i); feed h_i to the existing RQ levels and leave everything downstream unchanged. Pseudocode: for each epoch: refresh C with no_grad; for each of the 24 steps: E = Pi(s*f_theta(x_batch)); for each i in batch: if S_i empty then h_i=E_i else u_i=sum_j p_ij*log_{E_i}(C_j); h_i=exp_{E_i}(alpha_i*u_i); z_q, codes = RQ(h_i); loss = existing reconstruction + commitment on x_batch; backward. SID_i is still the tuple of codebook indices.
COST: Per step at the frozen scale, B=1024, d = the existing latent width (64 assumed for arithmetic), K = measured 90th-percentile out-degree (about 24 assumed): about 24.6k log/exp pairs and about 1.6M multiply-adds, roughly 5M extra FLOP per step, hence about 3.6e11 FLOP over 3000*24 = 72000 steps. The epoch cache adds 24556 item encodes per epoch, equal to the 24 training batches, so encoder forward roughly doubles; expected Stage 2 wall-clock +10 to +25 percent, no extra epochs, no extra seeds, no ablation run, and Stage 3 is unchanged except that it consumes different SIDs. Memory: cache about 6.3 MB for 24556 x 64 float32, transition rows about 2.4 MB for K=24. Measured quantities K and s are computed once and frozen, so no sweep is needed.
HYPOTHESIS: If successor superposition in the Poincare ball makes training-adjacent items share level-1 digits without collapsing codebook usage, then the generative model's next-prefix prediction improves and Stage 3 test Recall@10 exceeds 0.065. It is worth keeping only if the level-1 co-location rate on held-out training transitions rises, the level-1 code perplexity does not fall, and the frozen #126 hard Q_H recomputed on the new SIDs rises together with recall; a rise in Q_H with no recall movement would say the proxy is still not sufficient.
RISKS: Euclidean content reconstruction fights the flow and the encoder may learn latents with very small norm so exp/log degenerates to identity; the measured median rescaling mitigates this but does not prove the curvature is useful. Popular successors can dominate and pull many items onto one code, producing collisions and codebook collapse. The per-epoch cache can be stale early in training. The flow can oversmooth and destroy fine-grained content distinctions needed by later RQ levels. The extra encoder pass may be too expensive at 3000 epochs. A single seed cannot separate these effects from seed noise.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed consecutive item transitions, damped by successor branching, where branching is measured by out-degree d_i and successor entropy H_i of the same transition row.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: From the Stage 2 training split only. For every training sequence and every consecutive pair (u_t=i, u_{t+1}=j) add one to A_ij; do not use co-consumption, skips or reverse edges. Row-normalise p_ij = A_ij / sum_k A_ik; d_i = number of j with A_ij>0; H_i = -sum_j p_ij ln p_ij in nats; S_i is the top-K support of row i after renormalisation, with K = ceil(quantile_0.9({d_i})) measured once on the training split and frozen. Rows with no outgoing transition have S_i empty and are passed through unchanged.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: A, d_i, H_i, K and s are computed from Stage 2 training sequences and from training-item encoder outputs only, before or during Stage 2, and are frozen before any validation or test item is scored. Validation and test interactions never enter A, the cache, K or s. Validation sequences may be used only to record diagnostics after the SIDs are frozen; they are never fed back into training, early stopping, checkpoint choice or codebook selection. Stage 3 trains on training SIDs and is evaluated once on test, so no test transition can influence the SID construction.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare ball of dimension d with fixed negative curvature kappa = -1, unit ball radius, metric factor lambda_x = 2/(1-||x||^2), Mobius addition, exponential and logarithmic maps, and geodesic interpolation. The curvature is fixed at -1 and is not tuned or learned.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In the Stage 2 forward pass, between the RQ-VAE encoder output and the first residual-quantization level, for every training batch. It acts on the latent that is quantized; it does not act on the Stage 3 model.
COUPLING PATH: A -> p_ij, d_i, H_i -> alpha_i and the tangent weights -> log maps at E_i of the cached successor latents -> weighted tangent vector u_i -> exp map back to the ball -> h_i -> existing RQ levels -> SID tuple -> Stage 3. Removing behaviour sets p to the identity so u_i = 0 and h_i = E_i; removing geometry replaces the log/exp interpolation by a linear blend. Either removal changes h_i and therefore the SID assignment, so both factors are inside one connected computation.
COUPLING EQUATION: h_i = exp^{kappa=-1}_{E_i}( alpha_i * sum_{j in S_i} p_ij * log^{kappa=-1}_{E_i}( sg(E_j) ) ), with E_i = Pi(s * f_theta(x_i)), alpha_i = 1/(1 + ln(1+d_i) + H_i), p_ij from training transitions, and sg the stop-gradient cache.
OBSERVABLES: Mean and median geodesic displacement ||log_{E_i}(h_i)|| and mean latent norm, which show whether the curved operator is active; fraction of held-out training transitions whose endpoints share the level-1 digit, before and after; level-1 code usage entropy, perplexity and collision rate, to detect collapse; held-out-training prefix probe accuracy P(level1(j) | level1(i)); the frozen #126 hard first-level score Q_H recomputed on the new SIDs as a read-only diagnostic; and the primary Stage 3 test_recall@10 against the 0.065 target.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: A configuration flag makes p_ij = delta_ij, d_i = 0 and H_i = 0, so u_i = 0 and h_i = E_i exactly. The code path and the cached tensors still exist, but the latent is the baseline latent and the SID is the baseline SID. This arm is implemented and unit-checked but is not trained in this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: A configuration flag replaces exp/log with their Euclidean limits, giving h_i = (1 - alpha_i) E_i + alpha_i * sum_j p_ij sg(E_j), i.e. the same behaviour weights and the same step sizes without curvature. With behaviour off as well this reduces to h_i = E_i, so the two switches are independent. This arm is implemented and unit-checked but is not trained in this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The full equation h_i = exp_{E_i}(alpha_i * sum_j p_ij log_{E_i}(sg(E_j))) with curvature -1. This is the single trained candidate of the round; no other arm is run.
SPEC EQUATIONS: Pi(z) = z * min(1, (1-eps)/||z||) with eps=1e-5. lambda_x = 2/(1-||x||^2). x (+) y = ((1 + 2<x,y> + ||y||^2) x + (1 - ||x||^2) y) / (1 + 2<x,y> + ||x||^2 ||y||^2). exp_x(v) = x (+) ( tanh(lambda_x ||v|| / 2) * v / ||v|| ). log_x(y) = (2/lambda_x) * artanh(lambda_x ||(-x)(+)y||) * ((-x)(+)y) / ||(-x)(+)y||. u_i = sum_{j in S_i} p_ij log_{E_i}(sg(E_j)). alpha_i = 1/(1 + ln(1+d_i) + H_i). h_i = exp_{E_i}(alpha_i u_i). SID_i = RQ(h_i). s = 0.5 / max(median_{i in train} ||f_theta(x_i)||, 1e-6), measured once at the end of epoch 1 and frozen, so the median training latent sits at half the available radius and the curvature is not inert.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs are the item content x_i, the existing RQ-VAE encoder f_theta, the sparse training transition matrix A, the measured K and s, and the detached per-epoch cache C. Outputs are h_i in the open unit ball for every batch item, which replace E_i as the input to the unchanged RQ levels, and consequently the SID tuple per item. The operator returns E_i unchanged for items with an empty successor set or a zero tangent vector.
SAFEGUARDS: Project every latent with Pi before any map; clamp 1-||x||^2 to at least 1e-5 in lambda_x; clamp the artanh argument to at most 1-1e-7; if ||(-x)(+)y|| < 1e-12 return zero tangent; if ||v|| < 1e-12 return x; renormalise each transition row and drop rows whose mass is zero; cap each row at the measured K and renormalise; stop-gradient the cached neighbour latents; refresh the cache once per epoch; if any h_i is non-finite replace it by E_i and increment a counter; keep s and K frozen after their single measurement; never read validation or test data in the transition matrix or the cache; keep the existing RQ-VAE loss and optimizer unchanged so the only new constants are the measured K and s and the documented numerical epsilons.
END IDEA`;
const r = await tools.progress.append_progress({content: `FINAL ANSWER (single idea, GYROSUCC-SUPERPOSE) recorded verbatim below. The mechanism inserts one curvature-anchored successor-superposition layer between the existing RQ-VAE encoder and the residual quantizer, so the behaviour signal (training-only directed transitions with successor-degree and successor-entropy damping) and the hyperbolic operator (Poincare exp/log at fixed curvature -1) meet on the single path that produces the latent which is quantized. The behaviour-off switch collapses the latent to the baseline E_i; the geometry-off switch replaces the geodesic interpolation by a linear blend; only both-on is trained once. The idea is distinct from the rejected assignment, hierarchy, residual, codebook-Frechet, curvature-per-branch, Lorentz-cone and prefix-score mechanisms and does not optimise or re-run the #126 proxy (Q_H is a read-only diagnostic). Cost at the frozen scale is roughly 5M extra FLOP per step and one extra encoder pass per epoch, about +10 to +25 percent Stage 2 wall clock, with a 6.3 MB cache. Open questions: whether the measured median rescaling keeps the curvature materially active, whether content reconstruction prevents oversmoothing, and whether level-1 co-location translates into test Recall@10 above 0.065.
${ans}`});
return String(r);
